verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/PEO product, so configuring multiple pay schedules across teams is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) or assigning different schedules to different groups. The department- and office-level overrides cover Xero accounting line-item mappings, not pay schedules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
